$comment: The till's receipt names the seller as the boards draw it (PqKassabon, PqKassabonnen, PqKassaAfrekenen): Gemeente Zuiddrecht, Stadhuisplein 1, 2999 AA Zuiddrecht, with its KvK and VAT number. The postcode is in the set's made-up 2999 range and the numbers are fictitious. ReceiptService::companyAddress() joins street, postcode and city into one line.
